mediaComposer.scope: read-only static native MDB version/layout analysis

findings.claim: Both traced ordinary MDB read paths invoke the legacy omfiHPDomain directly in container mode 1, not omf2Domain.

evidence.detail: x0 stream; w1=0, w2=1, w3=0 then omfiHPDomain::New.
The independent media-stream cache MDB route makes the same direct call.

findings.claim: The traced ordinary MDB domain requires a Bento label with major 1 and minor 0; unsupported versions raise omfiHPDomain_UNKNOWN_VERSION.

evidence.detail: Reads explicitly named Bento Major Version / Bento Minor Version; cmp major1 and minor0 required.

findings.claim: The installed application separately contains a real OMF2 domain reader whose Bento label gate accepts major 2 and minor 0, not arbitrary later versions.
findings.limitation: This is general OMF-format capability. It does not prove that the ordinary MDB directory loader accepts a Bento2.0 MDB, because both traced MDB routes use the legacy 1.0 gate.

findings.claim: Both legacy and OMF2 object domains explicitly accept II and MM metadata byte-order marks.

evidence.detail: Reads object1 container byte order, accepts 0x4949 or 0x4d4d; other marks raise UNKNOWN_BYTESEX.
Same two accepted byte-order marks in the separate OMF2 domain.

findings.limitation: These marks describe numeric byte order, not text encoding; they are not reliable Mac/Windows provenance markers.

findings.claim: The legacy HP writer emits a Bento1.0 trailer and a two-byte legacy header-version spelling 00 01.

evidence.detail: Prepares short0x0100 as bytes00 01 on arm64, translates propertycode0x11, emits two bytes. The property name is not re-derived from its native dictionary in this audit; correlate with independently verified dictionary/corpus.
Builds24-byte label; major1/minor0 at labeloffset12, writes label to stream.

findings.claim: Application version26.8.0.58987, Bento container version, OMF metadata revision and PMR v8/v16 record sets are different version numbers.
findings.detail: A modern application can write/use an old Bento/OMF layout with additional privately named properties. UTF8 fields do not by themselves turn a Bento1.0 MDB into Bento2.0. PMR set selectors are unrelated to MDB layout.

limits: Read-only static native inspection on installed arm64 libameLibrary.dylib. No Avid private APIs, application execution or malformed fixtures were used.
No complete all-callers proof across every library/plugin/application path; report the two verified ordinary MDB load paths and the separately verified general OMF2 reader.

No claim that every semantically valid OMF1 revision or every private Avid property is supported; the precisely verified native version gates are Bento1.0 for those MDB paths and Bento2.0 for the separate OMF2 domain.
OMF1/1xIMA toolkit families cannot automatically be translated to a native MDB compatibility promise without their actual record/property shapes.
No attached-drive MDB corpus was inspected by this subtask; parent handles live corpus inventory.
mediaComposer.recommendationToParent: Describe ordinary installed Media Composer MDB use as the legacy Bento1.0 family through the two traced native routes. Describe general OMF2 support separately, rather than implying all MDB revisions are accepted. Bella should use explicit observed/supported layout gates and classify unknown layouts as unsupported, preserving physical media rows.

mdvx.purpose: Read-only installed MDVx MDB version support audit for Bella requirements, 2026-10-21 Australia/Sydney.

method.native: Nine bounded routines freshly disassembled with system otool and exactly compared with retained text; CFStrings resolved directly from installed arm64 Mach-O slice.

mdvx.namingDistinction: Trailer/container major at +0x0c is Bento container major, not automatically the separately recorded OMF object-model revision. MDVx labels its refused container branch OMF 2; this diagnostic wording does not establish universal OMF revision-2 refusal.

findings.finding: mdb extension selects MDVxOMFI. This wrapper calls the common reader openFile and stores its boolean result.
Requires >=128 bytes and magic 0xd7726448a54d43a4 in final 24-byte trailer. Compares raw native 16-bit label word at +0x0c to 2; if equal it calls Reader02, logs, and returns false.
Routine only logs OMF 2 not supported, with no TOC decoding. This is positive evidence of unsupported container-major2 path in this installed build.

All other raw major words use Reader01. No check of minor version +0x0e or exact major==1 whitelist appears. Nonzero object count yields true. This is permissive fall-through, not a support promise for future versions.
Divides declared TOC byte length by24 and indexes 24-byte entries. The observed implementation is the legacy Bento1 fixed TOC reader, not a compressed Bento2 TOC reader.

Builds identity trees from object1 property IDs0x101e9/0x10202/0x10216 (legacy CompositionMobs/MediaData/SourceMobs). Uses counted 20-byte legacy MobIndex entries. Enrichment follows those trees and fixed legacy property IDs. No explicit OMF:Version/HEAD:Version schema revision dispatch or HEAD:Mobs/HEAD:MediaData catalogue path was found in these bounded ordinary routines.
findings.qualification: This supports describing ordinary MDB enrichment as legacy OMF1-style. It is not proof that no isolated newer/private properties can ever be read when their legacy-compatible IDs/layouts match.

findings.finding: Reader01 loads arbitrary global property/type names into dictionary; raw browser description looks up recorded IDs in that dictionary. Ability to name/display raw properties in a supported fixed TOC is not proof ordinary metadata enrichment understands their OMF schema.

Selects payload endian behavior using trailer word+0x0a==0x4949 and swaps some counted/scalar payloads otherwise. Container major/TOC offset/length loads remain native raw loads in inspected gate. A complete big-endian-container support promise is not established.

mdvx.comparisonSummary: Installed MDVx has a fixed legacy Bento1-style MDB reader and legacy OMF1-style catalogue enrichment. It explicitly refuses the Bento-major2 label branch that it logs as OMF 2 not supported. Other label words are not rigorously whitelisted, and success does not prove semantic support. Do not equate raw browser dictionary display with ordinary scanner schema support.
limits: No runtime MDVx scan, synthetic format execution or live UI comparison.
No exhaustive whole-program or schema coverage proof.
No independent big-endian MDB corpus execution.
No inferred support based only on strings, file extension, raw browser display, or missing rejection.

findings.fact: Generic OMF VersionType reads byte0 major and byte1 minor with kNeverSwab; metadata endianness must not generically swap these bytes.

Generic toolkit detects OMF2.0 versus major1 records separately from Bento container; OMF1 in Bento2 is classified IMA. It rejects newer OMF2 minor versions and major>2. This generic toolkit logic is not proof the installed ordinary MDB path accepts those families.

recommendedBellaSupport.status: Release-one baseline approved on 2026-10-21. This narrows current generic source capability and is not an assertion that other MDB variants never exist.
recommendedBellaSupport.container: Bento exactly1.0 with the fixed24-byte TOC and supported standard storage/continuation framing. Do not treat every1.x/future label as compatible.
recommendedBellaSupport.objectLayout: Concrete legacy OMF1/Avid MDB layout. Explicit qualified canonical1.0 marker01 00 and observed Avid00 01 spelling with legacyHEAD context; do not infer arbitrary byte swapping or inherit firstbyte01 anyminor acceptance.
recommendedBellaSupport.numericByteOrder: Recognized II and MM for supported numeric layouts, using checked endian helpers. Container order, metadata order and text decoding stay separate. GenuineMM MDB coverage still needs implementation validation; do not guess contrary/uncertain per-object overrides.
recommendedBellaSupport.identityAndText: Keep approved fullFileMobId/MasterMobId12/32 normalization and field-specific explicitUTF8/separateMacRoman rules. UTF8 properties and32byte IDs do not require a newer container version.
recommendedBellaSupport.deferred: Bento2/OMF2/IMA MDB variants and unknown/new versions identified as unsupported rather than interpreted speculatively. Preserve existing generic-format research/tests for future extension when an actual MDB or ordinary native path establishes a need.
recommendedBellaSupport.failureScope: Unsupported MDB metadata is ignored; discovered physical files and independent PMR/filesystem facts remain. Report unsupported separately from damaged. Approved damage boundaries and no-new-header-read policies remain.
recommendedBellaSupport.headerReaderScope: This proposal concernsMDBonly; it does not exclude OMF2 physical-media headers from the later OMF header requirements review.
recommendedBellaSupport.design: Fresh smallC++17/Qt6.5.3 typed format checks and endian helpers, not OldScanner adaptation or retained generic raw-property graph. No implementation yet.
recommendedBellaSupport.observedCompatibility: All6workingDBs and8fixture/copy paths observed are covered by this agreed family; no observed loss. Does not prove compatibility with every historical or externalMDB.
recommendedBellaSupport.performance: No measured speed/memory gain is claimed from excluding version2. The recommendation reduces unproved format scope and verification burden.
